segments.t: Back in the kitchen, the pill that Fedya swallowed in German's office begins to take effect. As Fedya slumps onto a table with a blissful grin, Viktor Petrovich realizes that German is taking powerful sedatives to control his rage. Let's listen to their discovery in Russian.
Тихо, что это сейчас с ним?
Шеф, мы там чуть не попались.
Феде пришлось выпить таблетку Германа.
Это какое-то сильное успокоительное.
Эй, ребята, она очень мощная.
А можно мне ещё одну таблетку?
Иди сюда, ты мой маленький.
Феде сейчас так хорошо от таблеток.
Значит, Герману без них будет плохо.
Эй, это очень смешная штука.
Шеф, теперь мы прижмём Германа?
Рано, у нас ещё нет приманки.
Now let's break down the effects of German's sedative pill line by line.
Тихо, что это сейчас с ним?

'Quiet, what is going on with him right now?' When Senya asks if quiet what is going on with him right now, Barinov has to answer fast. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Шеф, мы там чуть не попались.
'Chef, we almost got caught in there.' Barinov reminds Fedya that they almost got caught in there before the moment passes.
Феде пришлось выпить таблетку Германа.
'Fedya had to swallow German's pill.' Because Fedya had to swallow German pill, Barinov treats the matter as settled.
Это какое-то сильное успокоительное.

'This is some kind of strong sedative.' Explaining that this is some kind of strong sedative lays the cards on the table for Fedya. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Эй, ребята, она очень мощная.
'Hey, guys, it is very powerful.' Fedya mentions that guys it is very powerful so Barinov sees what is at stake.
А можно мне ещё одну таблетку?

'May I have one more pill?' Asking whether may he has one more pill puts Barinov right on the defensive. There is no "you" needed in the Russian here: one short word states the rule for everyone in the room.
Иди сюда, ты мой маленький.

'Come here, you little buddy of mine.' Noting that Barinov should come here Barinov little buddy keeps Senya's side of the story simple and clear. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Феде сейчас так хорошо от таблеток.
'Fedya feels so good from the pills right now.' Barinov explains that Fedya feels so good from the pills right now, keeping his voice calm and direct.
Значит, Герману без них будет плохо.
'That means German will feel bad without them.' Realizing that that means German will feel bad without them changes how Barinov handles the situation.
Эй, это очень смешная штука.

'Hey, this is a very funny thing.' Noting that this is a very funny thing keeps Fedya's side of the story simple and clear. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Шеф, теперь мы прижмём Германа?
'Chef, will we corner German now?' Asking whether they corner German now is how Senya puts Barinov on the spot.
Рано, у нас ещё нет приманки.

'It is too early, we do not have the bait yet.' Admitting that it is too early they do not have the bait yet shows Barinov being honest for a change. Russian expresses having something as "by me is", keeping the phrase short and grounded. Let's hear the kitchen scene with Fedya and Barinov again from start to finish.

Barinov knows that hiding German's pills is only half the battle—they still need the right bait to provoke him. Notice the adjectives meaning powerful and funny and the noun meaning bait. See you next time!
